round_note: Stocking stuffers take over: mini beauty sets, a cozy-latte frother, gift-box jewelry and plush toys, plus the advent calendars and tech that keep selling.

picks.name: Fire TV Stick HD
picks.why: The cheapest way to make an older TV smart, and one of Amazon's most-gifted devices every holiday season.

picks.name: Apple AirTag (2nd Generation)
picks.why: Track keys, wallets and luggage from your iPhone, with better range than the first version. Still discounted in early Black Friday deals.

picks.name: Kitsch Ice Roller
picks.why: A chilled stainless steel face roller for puffy mornings. A small, giftable self-care pick on this month's gift lists.

picks.name: LANEIGE Lip Glowy Balm
picks.why: Tinted, glossy lip balm that moisturizes without feeling sticky. A beauty best seller and an easy small gift.

picks.name: Maybelline Lash Sensational Mascara Gift Set
picks.why: Three mini Lash Sensational mascaras in a holiday box. An inexpensive stocking stuffer from a drugstore best seller.
picks.query: Maybelline Lash Sensational mascara holiday gift set

picks.name: PAVOI 14K Gold Plated Love Knot Studs
picks.why: Simple knotted stud earrings from one of Amazon's most popular jewelry brands. An affordable gift that looks more expensive.
picks.query: PAVOI 14K gold plated love knot stud earrings

picks.name: adidas Athletic Crew Socks (6 Pairs)
picks.why: Cushioned, moisture-wicking crew socks in a six-pack. A classic stocking stuffer that's discounted right now.
picks.query: adidas athletic cushioned crew socks 6 pairs

picks.name: Yankee Candle Balsam & Cedar
picks.why: A large holiday-scented candle that burns for up to 150 hours. One of Yankee's most popular winter scents and an easy hostess gift.
picks.query: Yankee Candle Balsam and Cedar large jar candle

picks.name: Godonlif Candle Warmer Lamp
picks.why: Melts candles from above with a lamp instead of a flame, with a built-in timer. A cozy gift that pairs with any jar candle.

picks.name: Zulay Kitchen Handheld Milk Frother
picks.why: A battery-powered wand for frothy lattes and hot chocolate at home. Comes in lots of colors and makes an easy stocking stuffer.

picks.name: YETI 16 oz Travel Bottle
picks.why: YETI's newer insulated travel bottle with a 360-degree lid, at its best Amazon discount since it launched this year.

picks.name: Bocce's Bakery Dog Advent Calendar
picks.why: Twelve days of all-natural dog treats. A fun way to include the dog in the holiday countdown.
picks.query: Bocce's Bakery 12 day advent calendar for dogs

picks.name: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026
picks.why: A build-a-day Star Wars countdown to Christmas, and one of the best-priced LEGO advent calendars this season.

picks.name: Bananagrams
picks.why: A fast crossword-style tile game in a zip-up banana pouch. A classic, inexpensive gift for game nights and travel.

picks.name: Squishmallows Disney Pajama Stitch
picks.why: A 10-inch Stitch Squishmallow in pajamas. Plush toys like this are among the most-requested kids' gifts this season.
picks.query: Squishmallows Disney Pajama Stitch HugMees 10 inch

picks.name: Murdle: Volume 1
picks.why: A best-selling book of murder-mystery logic puzzles that get harder as you go. A clever gift for puzzle lovers and white elephant swaps.
